note: Set A covers the same correct core facts as B and additionally captures the 40-tube quantity with its 2 X APSE-20 condition, the powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, the 1x4 cedar T&G siding, the steel condition on the 1/8" cable railing, and the W2 mark. Set B is clean but omits several of these important facts, especially the tube quantity and railing post material. Set A's main flaw is heavy repetition of the handrail, cable railing, finished floor and grade level facts under slightly different attribute names, plus one quote with reversed token order ("1.07 W1").
remarks: Source text contains the typo 'TONNGUE' (also 'TONGUE & GROOVE' appears in the image), faithfully reproduced by both sets. Both sets ignore the general sheet notes (e.g., spacing may be larger between solar thermal tube arrays; valves and piping not shown; door swing conventions) and the cement fibre board siding, which appear on the page and could have been claimed. The 1/4" = 1'-0" scale applies to both the South and West elevations; neither set attributes it to the South elevation.
